definitions.ask: Should the count in N<Ctrl+Shift+]> count sibling list items rather than physical lines?

choices.label: N counts sibling items below the cursor item; children ride along without using up the count
N counts physical lines like counted Alt+[/] and N#, so child lines use up the count

definitions.why: Matches "the current task and the 3 below it" even when tasks carry child lines
